preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner (or gain ownership through transferOwnership)
Contract must have a non-zero native token (BNB) balance

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call the withdraw() function to drain all BNB from the contract to the owner's address. The function has no access control beyond the onlyOwner modifier, allowing the owner to extract all accumulated fees and liquidity pool ETH. No other steps are needed beyond ownership and sufficient contract balance.
